summary.zh-CN: 把受众问题变成有出处、可验证的选题；未知搜索量保持未知。
summary.en: Turn audience problems into sourced opportunities without invented search volume.

outputs.zh-CN: 机会卡 JSON；推荐下一验证动作
outputs.en: Opportunity cards and a next validation step

safety.zh-CN: 默认只读与本地产物；不自动修改生产、提交索引或外发。
safety.en: Read-only analysis and local artifacts by default; no automatic production changes, indexing submission or outreach.
